svg.title: Maknae standards profile (DoDAF StdV-1)
svg.desc: The technical standards Maknae conforms to, the elements each applies to, whether the claim is mechanically enforced, and the evidence for it.
svg.text: The technical standards Maknae claims, the elements they apply to, and what enforces each. Status separates what is mechanically
checked from what is merely implemented — a profile that blurs the two is a wish list.
implemented, and CI or the runtime refuses a violation
crates/maknae-vault/src/csr.rs — rejects a CSR whose key is not a 97-byte P-384 point
ADR-0020; AGENTS.md currency guard names it as the fixed vocabulary
all crypto operations; Vault leg, plane mTLS
Maknae-CONTROLLED channels: client plane (UDS), machine plane
outbound to THIRD PARTIES: Vault leg today; model/MCP endpoints later
rustls implements only 1.2/1.3 — no older path exists; suites FIPS-restricted either way via assert_f…
implemented and relied upon; not mechanically checked
ADR-0006 — the three candidate strategies were evaluated against it
ADR-0019 (audit record model); ADR-0006 D4 (visit clock, SC-10/AC-12)
applies to a surface not yet built
ADR-0006 D5 — REQUIREd properties; gateway is #117, unbuilt
deliberately out of scope, decision recorded
ADR-0007 §Out of scope — deferred to the external DCS library
Every row names evidence a reader can open. A claim with no evidence does not belong in this profile.
